install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-/opt/nvm}"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install && NODE_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(nvm which current)")")" && ([ -w "$NVM_DIR" ] && ln -sfn "$NODE_DIR" "$NVM_DIR/current" || true) && EXPORT_LINE="export PATH=\"$NODE_DIR/bin:\$PATH\"" && (grep -qxF "$EXPORT_LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$EXPORT_LINE" >> ~/.bashrc) && export PATH="$NODE_DIR/bin:$PATH"; fi && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
